newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Singapore HK Prop shareholder may sell stake.
newsitem.headline: Singapore HK Prop shareholder may sell stake.

text.p: Singapore Hong Kong Properties Investment Ltd said its controlling shareholder Eastlite Industries Ltd (EIL) was in talks to sell control of the company.
EIL holds 62.275 percent of Singapore Hong Kong Properties.

The property company said in a statement to the stock exchange EIL had been approached by a certain institution on behalf of an independent third party which has not been identified to EIL to acquire a controlling stake in the company.
"EIL stated that the discussion is at a preliminary stage... No formal or informal agreement or understanding has been reached," it said.
The company gave no further details.
Shares of Singapore Hong Kong Properties resumed trading on Friday after a one-day suspension. Its share price was up HK$0.825 at $3.80 at the lunch break. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
